episodes.title: 'I Love You' and Auto Memoir Dolls
episodes.summary: Hodgins retrieves Violet from the hospital, as Major Gilbert asked him to look out for her. After they meet Gilbert's relatives, he offers her a job.

episodes.title: Never Coming Back
episodes.summary: Violet tries to adjust to her new job: she needs to learn typing, and her coworkers question whether she has the right demeanor for letter writing.

episodes.title: May You Be an Exemplary Auto Memoir Doll
episodes.summary: Violet enrolls in a Doll training course. Her classmate Luculia befriends her, though she has her own problems with her war veteran brother.

episodes.title: You Won't be a Tool, but a Person Worthy of that Name
episodes.summary: When Iris goes to her home village on an assignment, Violet accompanies her. Iris's birthday party sparks a disagreement with her family.

episodes.title: You Write Letters That Bring People Together?
episodes.summary: Princess Charlotte is to have a public correspondence with her betrothed, and Violet is entrusted with writing the letters on her highness's behalf.

episodes.title: Somewhere Under the Starry Sky
episodes.summary: Violet travels to the country of Astrea to work with transcribers copying damaged manuscripts. Her partner Leon has a past not unlike hers.

episodes.title: Nameless
episodes.summary: A playwright with writer's block and a tragic past summons Violet to the country of Genetrix to help him finish a script. They both learn about grief.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Violet learns that Major Gilbert is listed as missing in action, but his family members think he is dead. Unable to cope, she remembers the war.

episodes.title: Violet Evergarden
episodes.summary: Heartbroken, Violet withdraws from her job and questions whether she even has the right to be an Auto Memory Doll. Then, she receives a letter.

episodes.title: Loved Ones Will Always Watch Over You
episodes.summary: Violet travels to a countryside mansion to write letters for a war widow, but her young daughter Ann resents her presence.

episodes.title: 'I Don't Want Anybody Else to Die'
episodes.summary: Against Hodgins' wishes, Violet takes a job from a soldier at a military base in Ctrigall, a former enemy nation now engulfed in civil war.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: The Major's older brother is ordered to defend the signing ceremony from former Gardarik forces opposed to peace.

episodes.title: Auto Memoir Doll and "I Love You"
episodes.summary: The signing ceremony concludes, officially bringing an end to the war. While writing letters for an air show, Violet composes a letter to the Major.
